title: Edge Node Schema
description: Base schema for all edge types in the IGVF Catalog. Defines common required properties.

_from.description: Document handle of the source node, in collection/key form.

_to.description: Document handle of the target node, in collection/key form.

label.description: Non-method specific human readable label for the node or edge

class.description: The class of the data this record belongs to: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement, 'prediction' for the output of a computational model, and 'biological relationship' for a curated relationship.

method.description: Name of the experimental class or prediction model that produced this result.

name.description: Directional human readable label for the relationship, _from to _to.

inverse_name.description: Reversed directional human readable label for the relationship, _to to _from.

source.description: The database, dataset or organization that is a source for these data.
